name: agentic-engineering
description: Tools for building software with Claude Code agents — the parts that should not be improvised: how work is handed over, how a worker is stood up and stood down, and how a report is checked before it is believed.

plugins.name: agent-crew
plugins.description: Run a crew of Claude Code worker sessions under one coordinator: start and retire them in cmux panels, clear a worker's context between tasks without losing its identity, write task briefs that survive a context wipe, and verify what comes back. Ships a backend-developer, a read-only tester, and a solution-architect role that shapes the work before anyone implements it.

plugins.name: peer-review
plugins.description: Get a verdict on work that already exists — a plan, a document, an uncommitted diff, or the current branch's work — from a reviewer deliberately given no context beyond the artifact itself. Read-only: reports defects, leaves the decision to you.

plugins.name: sonar-followup
plugins.description: Stops a push to an open pull request from being the end of the job. After every push to a branch with an open PR, the agent is told to wait for the pipeline, read what the static analysis reported, check it is not looking at a stale run, and fix what its own commits introduced - without you having to remember to ask. Silent on every other command.
